items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday; DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
items.implication: Likely questionable or out; Dameon Pierce next man up if inactive. Smith limited improves return odds.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Pierce workhorse; Goedert/Wicks targets rise with McKee. Reverse if unexpectedly active.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled out vs Jaguars; S Jalen Pitre also out.
items.implication: Full backfield to Woody Marks who previously took 98% snaps and all touches post-injury.
items.opportunity: Near-workhorse carries/targets/snaps for Marks (RB2/FLEX despite tough JAX run D); possible elevated passing game.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is out for Sunday and indefinitely with a superficial blood clot in his calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; Tanner McKee will start. Full team statement details timeline from cleat injury through London game clearance to Wednesday night update.
items.why: Blood clot movement confirmed; health priority, treatment course TBD.
items.implication: McKee starts behind makeshift line; Eagles offense downgraded significantly, low team total.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining pass-catchers if healthy; TE/RB volume shifts.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return with shoulder injury mid-TNF, then returned to the game and active.
items.implication: Played through; monitor for lingering effects but available.
items.opportunity: No major beneficiary shift; full routes/targets resumed.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle WR28 vs SEA (pre-game)

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore did not practice second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Questionable/out risk; Keon Coleman or others benefit if sits.
items.opportunity: Target share to remaining Bills WRs.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love did not practice for second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle (lingering/second issue); coach wants to get right.
items.implication: Game-time or out risk vs Rams; Tyler Allgeier lead if sits.
items.opportunity: Allgeier snaps/carries expand if Love inactive.

items.text: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee) will not travel with the team to London and ruled out vs Jaguars, alongside Montgomery and Pitre.
items.implication: More targets for remaining WRs/TE in London game.
items.opportunity: Nico Collins and others see expanded route/target share.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again due to hamstring.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for KC WRs if out.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again (ankle).
items.implication: Questionable; Huntley if out. Flowers limited too.
items.opportunity: If out, backup QB and remaining skill elevated usage.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans as WR4 vs Commanders; ALL IN. Season-high 36% target share Week 5; over 45% routes when Deebo off field. Deebo out multiple weeks, thin depth behind.
items.why: Target share spike + Deebo absence + soft WSH secondary.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets/red-zone vs weak pass D.

items.text: Patriots TreVeyon Henderson out multiple weeks high ankle sprain. When inactive Week 1, Rhamondre Stevenson 85% snaps/23 touches; averages 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches since 2024. Giddy up on volume.
items.implication: Stevenson clear lead back vs NYJ.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs Falcons.
items.implication: Expected to play; Bears offense stabilized.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty said he is feeling great and this is the best he’s felt this season.
items.implication: Full role expected; positive for volume.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz etc). Saquon Barkley turns 30 in February; if Super Bowl contender with RB need, I'd at least call. Better risk moving year early than late.
items.implication: Trade value now while contending; long-term risk.
items.opportunity: Monitor for potential role change or exit; handcuffs rise.
